scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: rm -rf dist-test && npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/unit/**/*.test.js && rm -rf dist-test
scripts.test:e2e: rm -rf dist-test && npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/e2e/**/*.test.js && rm -rf dist-test
scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf dist-test && npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --experimental-test-coverage dist-test/test/**/*.test.js && rm -rf dist-test
